title: Enforce the allowlist on every session, not only at first sign-in
description: Cognito's pre-sign-up trigger only fires when a federated user is first created, so removing someone from the allowlist later does not block an existing user. Check the allowlist in the control Lambda on POST /session (or delete the user from the pool). Specify with Gherkin first.
right_now_summary: The team must check the allowlist on every session to block removed users.
